# op_generate_password (Action)

Generates a 1Password password (random, PIN, or memorable) using the SDK password generator and writes it into a target item field, rotating the previous value.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `field_title` (String) Title of the item field to write the generated password into. Created as a Concealed field if absent.
- `item_id` (String) Item ID whose field receives the generated password.
- `mode` (String) Recipe: `random`, `pin`, or `memorable`.
- `vault_id` (String) Vault ID of the item whose field receives the generated password.

### Optional

- `capitalize` (Boolean) Memorable recipe: capitalize words (default true).
- `include_digits` (Boolean) Random recipe: include digits (default true).
- `include_symbols` (Boolean) Random recipe: include symbols (default true).
- `length` (Number) Length for `random` (default 32) and `pin` (default 6) recipes.
- `word_count` (Number) Memorable recipe: word count (default 4).
